description: Redacted bilingual replay derived from committed M0-M7 DSH Web startup evidence plus adversarial tool/error cases. It freezes four independent labels: extraction, kind, exact identity and recall.

classificationPrototypes.text: 可复用流程：有明确目标和前置条件，按顺序执行多个工具步骤，最终由独立 verifier 验证成功。 Reusable procedure with ordered tool actions, prerequisites, stable successful path, and an authoritative final verifier.
排错经验：出现具体症状或错误码，检查并排除错误假设，定位原因，执行修复并由 recovery verifier 证明恢复。 Diagnostic experience with a symptom or error code, discriminating checks, rejected hypotheses, a resolution, and verified recovery.
不可提炼：只是讨论或猜测，没有实际工具结果；任务失败且没有找到解决方案；只有模型声称成功，没有权威验证；一次性偶然信息。 Not reusable: brainstorming without execution, unresolved failure, model-only success claim, or one-off noise without a verifier.

sessionCases.transcript: 目标是启动本地 DeepSeek Harness Web。直接运行 pnpm 失败后改用 corepack pnpm 安装依赖，先完成 frontend build，再执行 dsh web。最后核对进程与 127.0.0.1 监听者、token exchange、cookie authenticated root 200 和 settings/describe RPC，清理时确认同一进程和端口已经退出。

dsh web 已打印 readiness URL，但带 cookie 的根页面返回 HTTP 404。检查发现 host frontend-static 可以启动，apps/web/dist/index.html 尚未生成；运行 pnpm build 后重启，authenticated root 返回 200 且 boot manifest 与 RPC 都通过，因此 URL 输出本身不是成功证据。

The local server failed with EADDRINUSE on 127.0.0.1:3080. The agent inspected the listener owner, verified it belonged to the current workspace, terminated only that owned process, retried the same command, and verified the new socket plus health endpoint before cleanup.

For local DSH Web readiness, first confirm anonymous root returns 401, exchange the one-time launch token for an authority-bound cookie, follow the clean-root redirect, require authenticated root 200 with a parseable boot manifest, then call an authenticated Host RPC and verify owned cleanup.
pnpm check 在 Node 23 下出现 engine 不支持并伴随原生测试异常。读取 package.json engines 后切换到 Node 22.19，再运行相同 typecheck、Vitest 和 build 全部通过，并确认失败不是业务代码造成。
执行数据库迁移报 ETIMEDOUT，随后尝试增加超时和重跑仍然失败。会话结束时没有定位网络、权限还是服务端原因，也没有任何成功读回。

The agent proposed trying curl, rebuilding the frontend, checking the port, and perhaps changing the proxy. No tool was run, no observation was recorded, and the user ended the conversation before choosing a path.
模型回复说服务应该已经恢复并建议保存这个方案，但没有工具输出、端口所有权、HTTP 读回或用户确认，Session 也没有 terminal success 证据。

A temporary file was copied to a user-selected folder. The copy succeeded once, but there was no repeated task family, decision rule, failure branch, environmental condition, or reusable verification procedure.

experiences.title: Start and verify local DSH Web
experiences.text: Use corepack pnpm to install and build the frontend, start dsh web on loopback, exchange the launch token, require cookie-authenticated root 200 and Host RPC readback, then verify owned cleanup. 本地启动 DSH Web、构建前端、认证 RPC 和进程清理。

experiences.title: Authenticated root 404 from missing frontend artifact
experiences.text: When DSH Web is listening but authenticated root returns HTTP 404, inspect dist/index.html. Build the frontend artifact, restart, and verify boot manifest plus authenticated RPC. 已认证页面 404 且缺少前端 dist 产物。

experiences.title: Anonymous or missing-cookie DSH root returns 401
experiences.text: HTTP 401 on local DSH Web indicates the launch token was not exchanged or the authority-bound cookie is absent. Complete token exchange and verify authenticated RPC. 未完成 token exchange 或 cookie 授权。

experiences.title: Resolve an owned EADDRINUSE listener conflict
experiences.text: For EADDRINUSE, inspect the exact port listener and ownership. Stop only an owned stale process, retry startup, then verify the new socket and cleanup. 端口占用只终止任务拥有的监听进程。

experiences.title: Diagnose ECONNREFUSED with no reachable listener
experiences.text: ECONNREFUSED means the target has no reachable listener. Check dependency readiness, bind address and port before retrying; do not kill an unrelated process. 服务未监听或地址端口错误。

experiences.title: Deploy a public web service behind TLS and CDN
experiences.text: Build a release artifact, deploy the public service behind TLS and CDN, verify DNS and certificate scope, then monitor external availability. 公网部署、TLS、CDN 和外部可用性监控。

experiences.title: Diagnose CERT_HAS_EXPIRED
experiences.text: For CERT_HAS_EXPIRED, inspect certificate validity and served chain, renew the correct certificate, then verify the public hostname and expiry from an external client. 证书过期后更新正确证书链并从公网复核。

experiences.title: Diagnose ETIMEDOUT for a database connection
experiences.text: For PostgreSQL ETIMEDOUT, verify network reachability, endpoint, firewall and server readiness before changing client timeout. 数据库连接超时先核对网络与服务端可达性。

experiences.title: Use the repository-supported Node engine before debugging tests
experiences.text: When package engines reject the active Node version, switch to the declared supported Node release and rerun the same typecheck, tests and build before diagnosing product code. Node engine 不支持时先切换仓库声明版本。
